messages.subject: effectplot variance
parts:
I haven't been able to find a solution through searching through this group, so I hope this isn't a redundant question.

Is there a way to print/show the value associated with the variance that's shown in the effectplot() output ( The vertical dashed lines capped by plus signs at each genotype )? 

Thanks,
Stephen

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: effectplot variance
parts:
The effectplot() function returns a list with the means and standard errors.
Consider this example:

library(qtl)
data(fake.f2)
fake.f2 <- sim.geno(fake.f2, step=5, n.draws=8)
mname <- find.marker(fake.f2, 1, 37)
output <- effectplot(fake.f2, mname1=mname)
output$Means
output$SEs

karl
